_about: Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712-1778): the Confessions, complete in twelve books, from Gutenberg (privately printed for the members of the Aldus Society, London, 1903; translator not named in the book). The Social Contract and Discourses (Cole, PG 46333) are on the Adler shelf, Emile on rousseau-emile, and Eloisa on singles-fiction-3; none is taken again. No uids minted.
